error.modelpricing.modelsDevCatalogParse.zh-CN: 价格目录格式或大小不符合读取要求。
error.modelpricing.modelsDevCatalogParse.en: The price catalog format or size cannot be processed.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceApiService..zh-CN: 请填写新价格，或选择要复制的历史版本。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceApiService..en: Enter a new price or select a historical version to copy.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceCatalogServ.zh-CN: 搜索内容最多 100 个字符，请使用有效的分页位置。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceCatalogServ.en: Use up to 100 characters and a valid page position.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceCoverage.va.zh-CN: 同优先级规则“{0}”与“{1}”存在重叠。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceCoverage.va.en: Rules “{0}” and “{1}” overlap at the same priority.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceCoverage.mi.zh-CN: 服务档位 {0} 在输入量 {1}、{2} 未覆盖全天价格。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceCoverage.mi.en: Service tier {0} does not have all-day pricing for input {1} on {2}.

error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.zh-CN: 请选择模拟请求的发生时间。
error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.en: Select the time of the simulated request.

error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.zh-CN: 填写缓存创建明细时，请同时填写创建总量。
error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.en: When entering cache creation details, also enter the total creation count.

error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.zh-CN: 缓存创建明细必须为非负整数，且不能超过创建总量。
error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.en: Cache creation details must be nonnegative integers and must not exceed the total creation count.

error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.zh-CN: 输入总量不能小于缓存读取和创建之和。
error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.en: Total input must not be less than cache reads plus cache creation.

error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.zh-CN: 模拟用量须为 0 至一千亿的整数。
error.modelpricing.modelPricePreviewServ.en: Simulated usage must be an integer between 0 and 100 billion.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceService.pub.zh-CN: 价格刚刚更新，请稍后重新发布。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceService.pub.en: The price was just updated. Publish again later.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceService.dra.zh-CN: 已发布价格不能修改，请复制后创建新版本。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceService.dra.en: Published prices cannot be edited. Copy one to create a new version.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 请选择有效币种。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Select a valid currency.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 每版价格最多配置 100 条规则。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Configure up to 100 rules per price version.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 价格规则不能为空。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Price rules must not be empty.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 基础规则的优先级为 0，其他规则为 1 至 1000。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: The base rule priority is 0. Other priorities must be between 1 and 1000.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 上下文上界必须大于下界，最大数量为一千亿。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: The context upper bound must exceed the lower bound. The maximum is 100 billion.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 请填写日期规则的覆盖截止日期，且不能早于已配置日期。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Enter the date rule coverage end date, no earlier than any configured date.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 每条规则最多配置 64 个时间段。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Configure up to 64 time periods per rule.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 请填写有效的星期、开始时间和结束时间。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Enter a valid weekday, start time, and end time.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 跨午夜规则的名称最多为 96 个字符。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: An overnight rule name must not exceed 96 characters.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 跨午夜规则的次日也必须在日历覆盖范围内。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: The following day of an overnight rule must also be within calendar coverage.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 拆分跨午夜时间后，每版最多 100 条规则和 2000 个指定日期。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: After splitting overnight periods, each version supports up to 100 rules and 2000 specified dates.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 价格规则名称不能重复。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Price rule names must not be duplicated.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 请配置且只配置一条基础价格规则。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Configure exactly one base price rule.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 基础价格必须覆盖标准服务的全部上下文、星期和时间。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: The base price must cover all contexts, weekdays, and times for standard service.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 规则“{0}”尚未填写单价。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Rule “{0}” has no unit price.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 每条规则最多配置 32 项单价。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Configure up to 32 unit prices per rule.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 计量项或缓存有效期不正确。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: The usage item or cache lifetime is invalid.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 同一计量项和缓存有效期的单价不能重复。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Unit prices for the same usage item and cache lifetime must not be duplicated.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 每百万单价须为 0 至 1000000，最多保留 12 位小数。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: The price per million must be between 0 and 1000000, with up to 12 decimal places.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 每版最多配置 2000 个指定日期。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Configure up to 2000 specified dates per version.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 指定日期不能重复，且必须选择包含或排除。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Specified dates must be unique and must choose inclusion or exclusion.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 价格来源请填写不含账号、查询参数或片段的网页地址。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Enter a price source URL without credentials, query parameters, or a fragment.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 请填写价格规则名称。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: Enter a price rule name.

error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..zh-CN: 内容过长或包含无效控制字符。
error.modelpricing.modelPriceValidation..en: The content is too long or contains invalid control characters.

error.modelpricing.modelsDevCatalogCache.en: Price retrieval was interrupted. Please try again.

error.modelpricing.modelsDevCatalogCache.en: models.dev prices are unavailable. Try again later or configure prices manually.

text.modelpricing.modelsDevPriceMapper.n.en: Only text prices are imported. Audio prices are excluded.

text.modelpricing.modelPriceCatalogServi.en: models.dev: {0}/{1}; public text pricing in USD, excluding special discounts or time-based rates.

text.modelpricing.modelPriceCatalogServi.zh-CN: 缓存创建价未导入，需按有效期补充。
text.modelpricing.modelPriceCatalogServi.en: Cache creation prices were not imported. Add them for the applicable lifetime.
